reading.title: The Impact of Renewable Energy on Modern Society
reading.passage: Renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power have revolutionized the global energy landscape in recent years. Countries worldwide are increasingly investing in these sustainable alternatives to reduce carbon emissions and combat climate change. Solar panels convert sunlight directly into electricity, while wind turbines harness kinetic energy from moving air. These technologies not only decrease dependence on fossil fuels but also create numerous job opportunities in installation and maintenance sectors. Despite initial high costs, the long-term economic and environmental benefits make renewable energy a viable solution for future generations.

questions.q: According to the passage, what are two main types of renewable energy mentioned?
options: A) Hydroelectric and geothermal
B) Solar and wind power
C) Nuclear and coal
D) Natural gas and biomass
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'Solar panels'과 'wind turbines'이 명시적으로 언급되었습니다. 따라서 태양광과 풍력이 두 가지 재생에너지 유형입니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of renewable energy?
options: A) Reducing carbon emissions
B) Creating job opportunities
C) Decreasing energy costs immediately
D) Reducing dependence on fossil fuels
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '초기 높은 비용'과 '장기적 경제적 이점'이 언급되어 있으므로, 즉시적인 에너지 비용 감소는 혜택으로 제시되지 않았습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about the future of renewable energy?
options: A) It will never replace fossil fuels
B) It is too expensive to implement
C) It provides viable long-term solutions
D) It creates only temporary jobs
questions.explanation: 'long-term economic and environmental benefits make renewable energy a viable solution for future generations'라는 문장에서 재생에너지의 미래가 긍정적임을 암시하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement that remote work is more productive than working in a traditional office? Support your opinion with specific reasons and examples.

structure.intro: 의견을 명확하게 제시하는 도입문 작성. 찬성 또는 반대 입장을 직접적으로 표현합니다. (2-3문장)
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 이유를 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명. 주제문으로 시작하고 증거 또는 구체적 사례 포함 (4-5문장)
structure.body2: 두 번째 주요 이유를 추가적인 설명과 함께 전개. 첫 번째 본론과 상이한 관점 제시 (4-5문장)
structure.conclusion: 의견을 재정리하고 전체 주제를 요약. 미래의 영향 또는 일반화된 결론으로 마무리 (2-3문장)

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer learning new skills through online courses. Others prefer learning through traditional classroom settings. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer... because...
I believe this is important because...
Let me explain why I think this way.
sample_points: 온라인 학습은 시간과 장소의 제약이 없어 바쁜 일정을 가진 사람들에게 유연성을 제공합니다.
전통 교실 학습은 강사와의 직접 상호작용과 동료 학생들과의 협력을 통해 더 깊이 있는 이해를 돕습니다.

listening.title: Student-Professor Conference about Research Project
listening.script: Professor: Hi Sarah, I reviewed your research proposal for the environmental science project. Overall, it's quite impressive, but I have some suggestions. Sarah: Thank you, Professor. I'd appreciate your feedback. Professor: Well, your topic about urban green spaces is excellent, but your methodology section needs more detail. You should specify exactly how you'll collect data and which areas you'll study. Also, consider adding more recent studies to your literature review. Sarah: I see. So you want me to be more specific about my research methods and include newer sources? Professor: Exactly. Additionally, your timeline seems a bit ambitious. You've planned to complete interviews with 50 residents in just three weeks. Maybe increase that to five weeks and focus on quality over quantity. Sarah: That makes sense. I'll revise the proposal and submit it next week. Professor: Excellent. I'm confident your revised version will be much stronger.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: A) To discuss the professor's research experience
B) To provide feedback on Sarah's research proposal
C) To explain environmental science concepts
D) To recruit participants for a study
questions.explanation: 교수가 Sarah의 연구 제안서를 검토하고 피드백을 제공하는 것이 대화의 주요 목적입니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, which aspect of Sarah's proposal needs the most improvement?
options: A) The topic selection
B) The data collection methodology and timeline
C) The introduction section
D) The conclusion
questions.explanation: 교수는 methodology 섹션을 더 상세하게 작성할 필요가 있고, 타임라인이 너무 야심차다고 지적했습니다.

questions.q: What does the professor suggest Sarah should do regarding the timeline?
options: A) Complete the project in two weeks
B) Keep the original three-week schedule
C) Extend it to five weeks and focus on quality
D) Interview 50 residents in one week
questions.explanation: 교수는 3주를 5주로 연장하고, 양보다 질을 중시하라고 조언했습니다.
